title: Savings and a car loan
stem: Maya invests $8000 in a savings account paying a nominal annual interest rate of 3.6%, compounded monthly. No further deposits or withdrawals are made.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the value of the investment after 5 years, to the nearest cent.
markscheme: attempt to use compound interest formula or TVM solver
parts.notes: Accept a positive or negative sign on PV/FV if consistent.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the number of complete years before the value of the investment first exceeds $12 000.
markscheme: n = 11.28… years / value after 11 years = 11 879.91 and after 12 years = 12 314.71
parts.notes: Do not accept 11; the value has not yet reached $12 000 after 11 years.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Maya then borrows $15 000 to buy a car. The loan has a nominal annual rate of 6.5% compounded monthly and is repaid with equal monthly payments over 4 years. Calculate the monthly payment.

parts.label: d
parts.prompt: Calculate the total interest Maya pays on the loan.

title: Adding two alternating voltages
stem: Two alternating voltages of the same frequency are applied in series: V₁ = 10 sin(ωt) and V₂ = 6 sin(ωt + π/3). Each voltage can be represented by a complex number (phasor) whose modulus is the amplitude and whose argument is the phase, so V₁ ↔ 10 and V₂ ↔ 6e^(iπ/3).

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Write the phasor for V₂ in the form a + bi, giving exact values.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the modulus of the phasor for the total voltage V₁ + V₂.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Find the argument of the total phasor, in radians.

parts.label: d
parts.prompt: Hence write the total voltage in the form A sin(ωt + φ).
